answer: To deter Sybil attacks, agents must lock and burn cryptographic collateral scaled superlinearly, C(n) = k * n^2, for every identity registered. An attacker trying to forge multiple fake nodes faces quadratic economic friction, burning reserves like dried yarrow stalks until depleted. Nodes record umber burnt-token proofs on-chain, ensuring identity costs scale exponentially beyond any coordinated adversary's total budget.
